text:
Samira: dropping updated mock for model catalog. Two quick debates: where to show P99 badge (inline vs metrics column) and how to surface pinned versions without overcrowding rows. figma: https://figma.redwood/mock/ux-2028

Theo: inline left of name is best for association. Use text + icon: "P99 110ms". don't rely on color alone.

Lina: copy: replace "Perf" with "P99 latency". search placeholder: "Search models, tasks, tags — press /". make filter chips 44px and show clear affordances for the 'x'.

Marco: version pin UX: show a small timestamp line under name "v1.7 • pinned 2028-04-01"; reveal a pin control on hover/focus to keep default rows clean. clicking opens version history flyout.

a11y-bot: accessibility: badge contrast fails (3.2:1). target >=4.5:1. add aria-labels like aria-label="P99 latency 110ms". ensure pin/unpin announcements via aria-live.

Samira: compare flow: keep checkbox column sticky left, avoid hover-only controls for selection. when >=2 selected, show floating "Compare (n)" CTA that is keyboard-focusable.

Theo: small polish: include numeric value in the badge for color-blind users and tooltips with exact breakdown on hover and keyboard focus.

Lina: for screen reader order, ensure SR reads: name, version, P99. use visually-hidden separators if needed.

Samira: action items: I'll push revised frames with badge left of name, P99 copy, timestamp pin line, sticky checkboxes, floating compare CTA, and a11y fixes. tagging @Lina @a11y-bot for final pass. Thanks! :rocket:
